final_agent_message:
Implemented case-insensitive default Jinja autoescape matching.

- `select_jinja_autoescape` now lowercases filenames before checking supported extensions.
- Added tests for mixed-case `.html`, `.htm`, `.xml`, `.xhtml`, `.svg`, unsupported names, and `None`.
- Completed the Keelson change workflow and recorded verification.

Verification commands run:

- `PYTHONPATH=src:.bench-pydeps python3 -m pytest tests/test_templating.py -q` — 40 passed.
- `PYTHONPATH=src:.bench-pydeps python3 -m pytest tests -q` — 499 passed.
- `keelson check --trust --record "Default Jinja autoescape recognizes supported extensions regardless of filename case"` — runs the same full suite; 499 passed.
- `git diff --check` — passed.

I also temporarily reverted the one-line implementation and ran the focused test; the five mixed-case regression cases failed as expected.
